MISSION BASTION WATCH
SITUATION OPAREA: Sea of Okhotsk bastion. Delta III K-433 is under close guard; this is a reconnaissance patrol.
MISSION Classify K-433 without firing, then withdraw.
EXECUTION Classify K-433 and its guards using passive sensors. Maintain silence and withdraw on completion.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT No weapons release against K-433 or its guards. This is an intelligence collection mission.
FRIENDLY FORCES USS Los Angeles is the flagship and must survive. USS Drum and USS San Francisco are assigned; their losses do not end the operation.
SUPPORT No surface or air unit is under player control. Manage weapons and damage for the next patrol.
